youtube_title: Crowd Crush at a Mela: Push Back or Exit Diagonally? Brave vs Normal #20 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL, WHO'S RIGHT? #20. The mela crowd suddenly starts crushing and it's hard to breathe. Brave pushes back against the crowd. Normal keeps his arms in front of his chest and slips out diagonally between the waves. Comment B or N.
Answer: NORMAL. Fighting the crowd burns your strength and your breath. Crowd-safety experts say: go with the wave and move diagonally, to the side, towards the edge in the lulls. Keep your arms up in front of your chest like a boxer to protect breathing space. Stay on your feet; if you fall, get up fast. Emergency: 112.
Source: crowd-safety experts (Prof. G. Keith Still, crowd science). General awareness.
